mapper.sql: r.id, r.student_id, r.type, r.level, r.name, r.reason, r.occur_date, r.operator, r.status, r.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , s.student_no AS student_no, s.name AS student_name, s.class_name AS class_name FROM reward_punishment r LEFT JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT , s.student_no AS student_no, s.name AS student_name, s.class_name AS class_name FROM reward_punishment r LEFT JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.id
AND r.type = #{type} AND r.level LIKE CONCAT('%', #{level}, '%') AND r.status = #{status} AND r.student_id = #{studentId} AND s.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentNo}, '%') AND s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentName}, '%')
ORDER BY r.occur_date DESC, r.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reward_punishment (student_id, type, level, name, reason, occur_date, operator, status) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{type}, #{level}, #{name}, #{reason}, #{occurDate}, #{operator}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM reward_punishment WHERE type = #{type} AND status = '生效'
